description: This file defines the AVOutput class, which is a plugin for the WPEFramework, providing AV output functionality. It includes class declarations, includes external libraries, and manages device-specific implementation through conditional compilation.

classes.name: AVOutput
classes.description: A plugin class for AV output, inheriting from a device-specific base class, implementing plugin interface methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the plugin, overridden from the base.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increases the reference count of the plugin.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a reference to the plugin.
